verdict.rationale: A probe confirms developer.nvidia.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a description of NVIDIA's developer portal, showing an agent could be pointed at an llms.txt-style resource covering NVIDIA's AI/dev ecosystem. However this is a generic NVIDIA-wide file, not RTX PRO 6000-specific, and companion probes (docs-md, openapi) 404, indicating no broader agent-oriented documentation surface. Missing for 10: product-specific agent-readable docs, markdown/API doc mirrors, and any first-party mention of llms.txt support.
